Marta (Marketing): Quick lock thread for next Wed webinar 'Serving Predictable Inference' 1: need final run-of-show, demo fallback clip, speaker one-pagers, and post-webinar follow-up plan.

Ike (Events): Rehearsal Thurs 14:00 confirmed. Green room opens 25m prior. Backstage channel #webinar-backstage.

Rina (Product): Demo will be live with routing failover. I'll prepare a 60s recorded fallback clip showing the pipeline and a short README with prompts.

Omar (Design): I'll make hero image + three social clips (30s hero, 45s demo, 15s CTA). Need fallback clip timestamp ranges after rehearsal.

Grace (SDR): Routing: tag leads by poll answer + time-attended. MQL if attended >= 20m OR clicked book-office-hours. Send high-interest to #sdr-live.

Marta (Marketing): Run-of-show draft: 00:00 host intro (2m); 02:00 product context (8m); 10:00 live demo (12m); 22:00 benchmarks (6m); 28:00 customer story (5m); 33:00 Q&A (15m); 48:00 CTAs & close (7m). Any timing tweaks?

Ike (Events): Add 2m mic swap buffer between demo and benchmarks. Recommend trimming keynote by 2m.

Rina (Product): OK to trim. Also I'll publish a small table in the benchmark doc: testbed (seq len, batch shape, GPU), mean/p99, and a short caveat.

Omar (Design): Owner summary: assets + clips = Omar; fallback clip export = Rina + Tom (Eng); run-of-show coordination = Ike; lead routing = Grace; emails + survey = Marta. I'll upload previews by Tue noon.

ops-bot: Webhook /sales/leads verified. Recording auto-upload enabled.
